# DeepFilterNet web bindings

`@lofcz/deepfilternet-web` 0.1.0, from <https://github.com/lofcz/DeepFilterNet>
and npm. The WebAssembly binary contains the DeepFilterNet3 model and runtime.
The package is distributed under MIT OR Apache-2.0; see the included license files.
The frame binding is modified to accept `wasmBytes` for local initialization.
The upstream stream worklet is not included or used.
